title: NIST: standard atomic weight of Rhenium (Re, Z=75) is 186.207(1)
summary: NIST prints the standard atomic weight field of Rhenium (Re, Z=75) as 186.207(1), with the isotope rows in the same file.
body: PubChem's periodic-table row names atomic number 75, symbol Re, as Rhenium. The NIST compositions file prints the standard atomic weight of Rhenium as 186.207(1). The parenthesis is the uncertainty NIST prints on the last digits of that standard atomic weight. It is an evaluated standard, not one laboratory weighing of one sample. The notes field on this element's rows is blank. Isotope rows in the same file: Re-185 relative atomic mass 184.9529545(13), isotopic composition 0.3740(2); Re-187 relative atomic mass 186.9557501(16), isotopic composition 0.6260(2). A relative atomic mass is scaled to carbon-12. An isotopic composition, when the field is not blank, is a representative mole fraction, not a new assay made for this card. The symbols for an interval, a parenthesis, a bracket, and a # mark are defined on world.chemistry.nist-atomic-weight-notation. This standard atomic weight is not the Chemistry WebBook molecular-weight field, which is a different catalog entry when one exists.
